newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on February 5:
WASHINGTON - Construction will begin within a month on the $50 million renovation of the vacant Garfinckel's department store building downtown.

NEW YORK - The Treasury Department wants to crack down on the more than $21 billion in esoteric securities sold by bank holding companies that allow the companies to avoid taxes on the dividends they pay to investors.

WASHINGTON - European Union officials said they have demanded the appointment of an international trade panel to rule on their complaint that a U.S. law tightening the embargo on Cuba violates global trade agreements.
WASHINGTON - Faster computer networks are the focus of the ComNet trade show at the Washington Convention Center this week.
